T39 Stage D, question 1 for the coordinator to route to the owner (L-08 / PL-08): **Keep the menu map's dated journal in the map, marked historical, or move it into the qa-logs it already links?**

The accepted reader pass records 279 lines under 16 headings after `## Not mapped`. Two headings still call closed #570 work pending. T39's authorized correction is those headings; moving the journal is restructuring and needs a recorded decision and stream brief. No map or journal edit has been made.

Evidence: [analysis, question 1](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/c61bcdcb5f2de47dfa35ac25776965e77f962914/docs/audits/2026_11_01-epic-m6-doctrine-reference/04-analysis.md#the-two-questions-for-the-maintainer-brief--4-posted-on-686-at-the-stage-d-pause), [PL-08](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/c61bcdcb5f2de47dfa35ac25776965e77f962914/docs/audits/2026_11_01-epic-m6-doctrine-reference/05-punch-list.md#pl-08-the-maps-journal-calls-closed-570-work-pending), brief ruling (b).

Please record the chosen disposition in the coordinator's stream brief, with a decision-register row if required. This is a prepared decision request, not a runtime or device permission request. Stage E remains on hold.

T39 Stage D, question 2 for the coordinator to route to the owner (L-12, L-13, L-18): **Keep each low-inbound reference document with a dated first line, or retire selected documents?**

The accepted Stage-C Q5 generator reports **33 low-inbound files, 2,770 lines**, from a population of 70 (69 table rows). This supersedes the earlier R2 C26 research subset of 17 files / 2,135 lines quoted in the historical question draft. The criterion is no inbound name from rules, root documents or October work logs, and at most one from `docs/`; it measures repository references, not actual readership. Examples include the council limits note, two rocknix.org stubs and a 590-line design note describing another repository.

Keeping an undated record can make a search result look current. Retirement requires the owner's selected paths and disposition; the lane will not infer deletion authority. A dated first line is the available correction where the eventual brief specifies it.

Evidence: [accepted Q5 table](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/c61bcdcb5f2de47dfa35ac25776965e77f962914/docs/audits/2026_11_01-epic-m6-doctrine-reference/04-analysis.md#q5-efficiency-the-lens), [generator receipt](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/c61bcdcb5f2de47dfa35ac25776965e77f962914/docs/audits/2026_11_01-epic-m6-doctrine-reference/stage-c/tables/q5.err), and PL-12/13/18 in [the punch list](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/blob/c61bcdcb5f2de47dfa35ac25776965e77f962914/docs/audits/2026_11_01-epic-m6-doctrine-reference/05-punch-list.md).

Please record the selected disposition and owned paths in the coordinator's stream brief, with a decision-register row if required. No removal has occurred; Stage E remains on hold.
